final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, '(missing)') AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, project_count, 1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_counts) SELECT status, project_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share
